name: RELENTLESS ONSLAUGHT
text: For this turning point, a Hierotek Circle operative firing at a target no more than 8 inches from itself gains Balanced on its ranged weapons. Through Magnify the 8 inches is still taken from the operative actually shooting.

name: UNDYING ANDROIDS
text: For this turning point, a Hierotek Circle operative that is shot with no cover save open to it sets one defence die aside as an automatic normal success and rolls the others.

name: METHODICAL ELIMINATION
text: For this turning point, Hierotek Circle melee weapons gain Accurate 1. It rises to Accurate 2 when retaliating, or when fighting in an activation where the operative has so far covered no more ground than its Move stat.

name: COMMAND UNDERLINGS
text: Pick one (both Support): every other friendly Hierotek Circle operative visible to and within 6 inches of a friendly Cryptek, or every other friendly Hierotek Circle operative except Cryptek visible to and within 3 inches of a friendly Apprentek, takes a free Dash at once, in the order you choose.

name: CORTICAL CONTROL
text: When a friendly Apprentek or Cryptek performs a Support unique action, until it ends the operative it picks for that action only has to be visible, whatever the distance. It does not apply to Timesplinter or to a Despotek's Interstitial Command.

name: REANIMATED FUNCTION
text: As control of a marker is settled, choose one of your Reanimation markers: up to the start of the next turning point it contests markers as if it were a friendly Hierotek Circle operative of APL 1.

name: LIVING LIGHTNING
text: An Immortal opening fire with a tesla carbine can let the lightning leap: for that Shoot the carbine trades the 2 inch reach of its Devastating for Blast 2 inches.

name: DIMENSIONAL AMBUSH
text: During a friendly Hierotek Circle Deathmark's activation while it has a Conceal order, it may perform Guard despite that order. When it uses the free action of the interrupt its order first changes to Engage.
